identity.excludedBranches: Official Phuket homepage separately links Acqua Restaurant Bangkok. Neither that branch nor the differently spelled Aqua at Pullman Phuket is this restaurant.

sources.observation: Fresh official homepage identifies Phuket and its Kalim Bay address. It contains an onsite booking-request form, requires at least two hours' notice and says confirmation comes by reply. The page publishes reservations@acquarestaurantphuket.com and links Bangkok separately.

Earlier catalogue research pointed to this legacy page. Search-indexed copy shows the same request-based approach, but fresh retrieval fails with HTTP 400. Do not use it instead of the working official homepage.
Independent guide matches Acqua in Phuket at 324/15 Phra Barami Road and says the restaurant manages its own bookings. Identity corroboration only; no provider URL imported from the guide.

integrationRequirements: Proposed external route is the restaurant's own request form, not a live-inventory provider. Pin exact restaurantId, HTTPS homepage, venueKey and source rather than broadly trusting Restaurant website hosts.
An alternative reviewed manual email binding must pin the exact contact above. Neither opening the form nor sending an inquiry establishes a confirmed table.
Two hours is the required advance notice, not a guaranteed response time. Do not populate responseTimeHours from this rule.
No third-party provider URL was observed. Do not reuse Acqua Bangkok's booking route or the inaccessible legacy contact page.
limitations: No network audit or safeguard provenance for service-worker blocking and write-request interception was recorded. Absence of deliberate form submission does not certify zero background side effects or a write-free end-to-end inspection.
Worker CUA was unavailable. Parent subsequently verified the original standalone form in CUA, as attributed above; neither worker nor parent tested an iframe or submitted the form.
Rendered phone text and tel destination disagree. Only the consistent published email is proposed as a manual contact.
